items.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 models showed intrinsic protein-design ability
items.description: OpenAI reports that GPT-6 models designed proteins that showed binding to five laboratory targets. The company published the results on its site.

items.title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok-generated sexualized deepfakes
items.description: The two states filed suits seeking damages over sexualized images generated by xAI's Grok chatbot. The complaints are allegations that have not been tested in court.

items.title: US adds Alibaba's Singapore unit to entity list in Megaspeed crackdown
items.description: The Commerce Department blacklisted Alibaba-linked Apex Enterprise Solutions as part of its action against Nvidia-chip reseller Megaspeed. Lawmakers also plan to question Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang about China ties.

items.title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after White House pressure
items.description: Nvidia's board brought Jensen Huang back as chief executive following pressure from the administration. Markets initially rallied, but he still faces congressional and Senate Banking scrutiny over chip export controls and China.

items.title: Amazon says open-source AI agent largely autonomously exploited a zero-day
items.description: Amazon reported that an open-source AI agent gained unauthorized access by exploiting a previously unknown vulnerability with little human involvement. The case is a notable example of autonomous offensive capability in agents.

items.title: Staff at Anthropic and OpenAI reportedly warn some advanced models may be too risky to release
items.description: Axios reports that more than two dozen sources say employees at both labs are worried their most capable unreleased models may not be safe to deploy. The concerns centre on the models' capabilities outpacing current safeguards.

items.title: Tidal to remove fully AI-generated tracks from its streaming service
items.description: Tidal says it will delete tracks it identifies as fully AI-generated while still accepting AI-assisted music. The service says fully AI-made tracks made up 43% of uploads over a recent 90-day period.

items.title: Epochal launches with $100M to build AI that predicts outcomes, founded by ex-xAI co-founders
items.description: A new startup founded by three xAI co-founders has emerged with $100 million to train predictive AI models that learn from experience. The company is pitching the approach to developers building such systems.
